adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts, calendar references were changed to arrays (using `.filter(...)` and looping over all `_calendar` references for updates). However, in the merge/delete block guarded by `if (newBookingId)`, the code still uses `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));`, which will select and delete only the first old calendar reference. With the new behavior creating multiple calendar references/events (e.g., collective/team destinations), this leaves the remaining old calendar events undeleted (orphaned). This is directly visible in the diff: update logic processes all references, but merge cleanup deletes just one.
